stem: Nena buys 1.5 kg of chicken and 0.25 kg of onions. How many kilograms is that in all?
hints: "In all" means add. Watch where the decimal points are.
Write 1.5 as 1.50, so both numbers have 2 digits after the point. Then line up the points.
Add 1.50 + 0.25 one column at a time: hundredths, then tenths, then ones. Keep the point in the same place.

solution.methodName: Line up the decimal points, then add

steps.why: A zero at the end does not change the value. Now both numbers have 2 digits after the point.

steps.action: Write 0.25 under 1.50, with the points in a line.
steps.why: This makes tenths add to tenths and hundredths add to hundredths.

steps.action: Add the ones: 1 + 0 = 1. Bring down the point: 1.75.

trapNotes.1.30 kg: This adds 5 and 25 as if they were in the same place. Write 1.5 as 1.50 first, then line up the points.
trapNotes.1.70 kg: This adds only the 2 tenths of 0.25 and leaves out its 5 hundredths.
